description: UI-only subset of IAU constellation metadata and boundary geometry intersecting the currently selected real-system seed catalog. This is not a complete 88-constellation atlas or an authoritative main-application catalog.
coordinate_system: Right ascension and declination in degrees. Boundary geometry is J2000-based.

coverage.scope: Only constellations containing at least one system in the current Sol-neighborhood seed selection.

sources.name: International Astronomical Union — The Constellations
sources.note: Defines constellations as sky areas bounded by celestial coordinates and publishes J2000 boundary coordinate information.

sources.name: D3-Celestial — constellation boundary GeoJSON
sources.note: GeoJSON boundary geometry used by this UI fixture; coordinates are longitude/right ascension and latitude/declination in degrees.

sources.name: D3-Celestial — data format documentation
sources.note: Documents the constellation boundary GeoJSON structure.
